name: UF-tandy-16-color-wide
note: Tandy/PCjr 160x200 16-color mode: EGA palette, pixel size 2x1 double-wide pixels. — unfake grid snap (true model grid, reduced to the canvas), despeckle 0. Twin of FACTORY/tandy-16-color-wide.  (sample: seed 1112)

form.subject: a (pirate ship:1.3) sailing past a (tropical island:1.2) at sunset, palm trees
